name: PST.NET Platinum Advertisement Card
summary: An elite virtual card solution for high-volume media buying teams and agencies, offering cashback and team management tools.

kyc.notes: Requirements as published by the provider; confirm during onboarding.

cons: Full KYC, including proof of address, required
Virtual card only — no physical card

faq.question: Does the PST.NET Platinum Advertisement Card charge a monthly fee?
faq.answer: Yes — it charges US$16 per month. Card issuance is US$16.

faq.question: What are the foreign-exchange fees on the PST.NET Platinum Advertisement Card?
faq.answer: There is no foreign-exchange markup on spending.

faq.question: What KYC does the PST.NET Platinum Advertisement Card require?
faq.answer: It requires a government ID plus proof of address.
